issue.title: bench_tui_jk.py fails to import: re-exports test_bench_sticky_reply_flag_off_vs_on renamed by sase-19x.9
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py` fails at import, so the whole j/k navigation benchmark
(`pytest -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py`) cannot run:

```
ImportError: cannot import name 'test_bench_sticky_reply_flag_off_vs_on' from 'tests.ace.tui.bench_tui_jk_blocks'
```

Root cause: 39f8e4ea4 (sase-19x.9, card-blocks flag removal) renamed
`test_bench_sticky_reply_flag_off_vs_on` to `test_bench_sticky_reply_heavy_sessions` in
`tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk_blocks.py`, but the re-export block in
`tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py` (around line 34-37) still imports the old name. Fix the
re-export to the new name and confirm the file collects (`pytest --collect-only -m slow
tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py`).

Proposed by sase-1ab.4 note #1 (turn-rename TUI phase); reproduced by the sase-1ab land
agent at sase master 7b20f4c1c. Epic sase-19x is closed, so there is no active owner.
The failure is not caused by the turn rename.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic collection-time ImportError: the imported name no longer exists in bench_tui_jk_blocks.py since 39f8e4ea4.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ab.4 note #1 and reproduced by the sase-1ab land agent; the j/k benchmark cannot run at all, and closed epic sase-19x left no owner.

payload.entry: Fixed by sase-1b2.land in the sase-1b2 landing: tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py now re-exports test_bench_sticky_reply_heavy_sessions (the renamed sase-19x.9 case) and the new test_bench_agents_jk_with_final_pinned. pytest --collect-only -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py collects all 13 benches.
